scope: PC-only painted 2D iso theme kit for the SOUTHBRIDGE open-world outskirts (PR #241 flat washes -> painted ground + props). Box-only; nothing committed.

files.overlays: overlays/<id>.png + overlays/<id>@2x.png (screen-space fog/haze; listed in animated/anim_meta.json as 1-frame scroll layers and in kit.json)

anchors.tile: bottom-centre on the cell south tip (= top-left at cell centre + (-32,-16) 1x)
anchors.prop: bottom-centre on the south tip of the south-most footprint cell

autotile.picker: Crosshaven picker (crosshaven_art.gd pick_tile): g = sides nw,ne,se,sw (in that order) whose neighbour is in `against`; g empty -> interior by h(x,y); else <edge_prefix><g joined by _>; then <corner_prefix><c> decals for diagonal corners c whose two sides are not in g but whose diagonal neighbour is in `against`.

against: golden_plains (no grass bank piece: keep a mud ring between grass and the pool)

autotile.note: all 15 side combinations are shipped (Crosshaven grammar); the 4 single sides are the brief's <family>_edge_{nw,ne,se,sw}. swamp_bank_* is drawn ON the water cell so the bank hugs the land side.

lighting.key: neutral warm daylight from the top-left (as Crosshaven)
